Hi Marissa — thanks for the summary and the packet. A few items from procurement / finance: 

1) Procurement path: Acme prefers to onboard via PO for vendor spend > $10k. For the pilot we can raise a PO (standard 30-day net). If you can accept PO, that's our preferred route.
2) Vendor packet: procurement needs the completed packet (we received the vendor setup PDF) plus a signed W-9 (we need the signature page to match your company signatory).
3) Banking details: for ACH we need a copy of the bank letter or a stub with account + routing; we also use our vendor portal for secure uploads (I can create a portal invite).
4) Marketplace: AWS Marketplace is preferred by our procurement ops team — if you can support marketplace invoicing that often speeds approvals. Please confirm whether Redwood is able/willing to list.

Timeline: If we receive the complete packet + signed W-9 and bank stub by end of week, procurement can issue a PO in ~7–10 business days.

Would you be able to provide a signed W-9 and a bank details stub (or upload to our portal)? If you prefer, we can accept the documents via the portal invite I'll send from procurement@acme-analytics.com.

Thanks — looping Michael (CFO) for visibility.

Best,
Janelle Ortiz
